scheme_name: Goa State Cultural Award for Institution
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Goan institution or an institution working for Goan artists in the field of Art and culture
Institution must have completed 15 years of operation
Institution must have made extraordinary contributions to Art and culture
Institution must have a properly constituted managing body with powers and duties clearly defined in its constitution
Institution must have a good reputation in the local community
Institutions financed by Central Government Corporations and Municipalities are also eligible
Preference will be given to institutions involved in Cultural Education such as training in Music, Dance, Drama, Fine Arts, etc.
benefits_summary: A memento and a financial purse of up to ₹3,00,000.
